title: What If One Cashier Served All of McDonald's?
description:
What if one cashier had to serve every McDonald's customer in a single day?

Sources:
- Wikipedia: McDonald's (68 million customers daily; 45,356 restaurants at end of 2025): https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/McDonald%27s

Per-second = 68 million / 86,400 seconds; per-restaurant = 68 million / 45,356. Not financial advice.

#shorts #mcdonalds #whatif #howtheymakemoney
loop: So next time you're in a McDonald's line, ask yourself:

scenes.narration: What if one cashier had to serve every McDonald's customer in a single day?
McDonald's serves about 68 million customers every day.
Our cashier would need to serve about 787 people every second. No breaks.
Instead, McDonald's spreads them across 45,356 restaurants in more than 100 countries.
That's about 1,500 customers per restaurant, every single day.
And about 95 percent of those restaurants are run by franchisees, not McDonald's itself.
